limitations: Only true first-excited Gaussian Landau level on centered disks in one complex variable
Threefold cutoff degeneracy and nonuniqueness at positive integer disk areas
No claim of priority for the known eigenvalue integral or basis
Other possible accidental non-cutoff ties not classified
scientific_integrity: Known Hermite disk diagonalization and radial eigenvalue integral are attributed to the earlier literature. The present theorem proves exact spectral ordering, cutoff triples and one-mode projection comparison by a new sign and two-step argument; finite checks supplement but do not prove the all-radius result.
title: An exact one-mode spectral exchange for first-Hermite disk localization
